persona: Drive test engineer moving into RAN optimisation
resumeText:
Rahul Verma | Noida | rahul.verma@example.com

EXPERIENCE
RF Drive Test Engineer, Indus Signal Services, Noida (2021 - present)
- Ran cluster drive tests for 4G and 5G NSA sites using TEMS Investigation and Nemo Outdoor.
- Analysed drive logs in Actix to find call drops, poor SINR and missing neighbours.
- Read Layer 3 messages to trace failed EN-DC additions and handover failures.
- Prepared daily KPI reports in Excel with pivot tables for the operator's circle team.
- Shared site audit findings with field teams and the client's optimisation lead each week.

EDUCATION
BTech ECE, AKTU, 2020

SKILLS
TEMS, Nemo, Actix, LTE, 5G NR, MS Excel, Atoll
